acknowledgement: Generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information; https://doi.org/10.48670/moi-00021
background: Mean of 187 profiles: two measured CTD casts plus 185 background-aligned 2021 profiles (37 days, five longitudes).
conversion: TEOS-10: potential temperature thetao -> CT_from_pt; practical salinity -> SA_from_SP; sound_speed(SA,CT,p).
depth: 376 knots at 10 m spacing, 0–3750 m. Background below measured 3242 m extended at 0.016 (m/s)/m.
taper: 1 through 3000 m; cosine to 0 at 3200 m; 0 below. No observed historical anomalies are claimed below this support.
caveat: Derived, bias-aligned daily reanalysis profiles, not raw measured historical sound speed. One profile is static throughout each simulated survey.
evidence: Retrospective calendar holdout: the full 2020 archive had already been explored. Validation values do not fit the new risk model or select routes.
